theorem free_time_accuracy (p : Family) (hm : 0 < p.m) (hn : 0 < p.n)
    (hS : 0 < p.S) (hρ : 0 < p.ρ) (hρone : p.ρ ≤ 1)
    (hL : 0 ≤ p.Lminus) (hD : 0 ≤ p.Lpm) (hΔ : 0 ≤ p.Δ) (hε : 0 < p.ε)
    (hA : 0 < familyCoefficient p.toWorkers.toBase p.S p.ρ)
    (hlarge : largeSample p.m p.n) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ) (lower Lplus : ℝ)
    (hreg : RegularObjective f p.x0 lower p.Lminus Lplus p.Lpm p.Δ)
    (τ : Fin p.n → ℝ≥0∞) (hmono : Monotone τ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hservice : PrimitiveService f τ O)
    (hind : batchScheduleIndependent (familyRaw p true) f τ O)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : eventLimit (familyRaw p true) ≤ N) :
    let q := familyRaw p true
    let P := (executionLaw q O : Measure (Seed q.K × ((a : ℕ) → O.Seed a)))
    let out := fun z : Seed q.K × ((a : ℕ) → O.Seed a) =>
      execute O (factory q) (fun _ => N) z.1 z.2
    Integrable (fun z => ‖gradient (objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2) P ∧
      (∫ z, ‖gradient (objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2 ∂P) ≤ p.ε ∧
      (∫⁻ z, ((out z).2 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂P) ≤ 12 * (equilibriumTime τ (p.m : ℝ≥0∞)) + ENNReal.ofReal (48 * p.Δ / p.ε * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * Real.sqrt ((1 - p.ρ) / (p.ρ * p.S)))) * (ENNReal.ofReal p.ρ * (equilibriumTime τ (p.m : ℝ≥0∞)) + ENNReal.ofReal (1-p.ρ) * (equilibriumTime τ (p.S : ℝ≥0∞))) := by sorry

theorem free_time_execution_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.spec.valid p) (f : Fin p.m → Space p.d → ℝ)
    (O : Oracle (Option (Request p.d p.m p.n)) (Reply p.d p.n) 1)
    (hO : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.spec.admissible p f O) :
    outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.spec.successful p f
      (fun z : (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.freeTime (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.publicInput p)).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.freeTime (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.publicInput p)) (fun _ => p.n * p.m + (p.n * p.m + p.S) * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * Real.sqrt ((1 - p.ρ) / (p.ρ * p.S))) / p.ε⌉₊ + 1)) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.freeTime (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.publicInput p)).law : Measure (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.freeTime (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.publicInput p)).Seed).prod
        (O.law : Measure ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k)), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem free_time_cost (p : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.spec.valid p) :
    eventLimit (familyRaw (outputs.Setups.FreyaPageTime.publicInput p) true) ≤ p.n * p.m + (p.n * p.m + p.S) * (⌈2 * p.Δ * (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * Real.sqrt ((1 - p.ρ) / (p.ρ * p.S))) / p.ε⌉₊ + 1) := by sorry

end outputs.Proofs.FreyaFreeTime
